properties.notes: The allocation promotes mixed use development appropriate to the town centre, including provision for community uses. An application (Ref. 172913FUL) for mixed use development including 59 units is currently pending. Whilst an estimate of 5 is given for the mimum net number of dwellings, this is the size threshold for eligibility for inclusion on the register, and where appropriate developments may need to exceed this in order to demonstrate that they have achieved optimum level of development for the site.. See allocation in Development Sites DPD (2013)
